record: W04-02 progress note 3 - not a receipt; step 4 still has unverified halves

not_verified: CHG-OPTIONAL-RETRIEVAL-DEGRADES: the optional-retrieval warning path needs the FTS/retrieval fixture (retrieval.go pushes warnings and continues); no assertion here yet

CHG-PROPOSAL-NAMES-ITS-IMPACT: impacted_refs and impact_link_ids stay empty on a proposal until analyzeChangeImpact runs, and that operation needs a settled orchestration fixture run (live EXECUTOR grant, authority root, frozen contract, trusted observation, sealed report) which is W06/harness territory. The deterministic links the freeze itself writes ARE asserted above.

CHG-REFREEZE-CARRIES-EFFECTIVE-DECISION: the applied decision is in the project state but the fresh freeze does not surface it in latest_decision_refs or its summary; the freeze reads the state field this change wrote, so the gap is in how the bundle picks decisions up and belongs to the card that owns the decision lineage (W04-03/W08), not to a fixture detail

CTX-BUNDLE-CARRIES-EFFECTIVE-AND-RETIRED-DECISIONS: the card asks the freeze to carry effective and deprecated decisions; the implementation reads them from the project state, so the assertion needs a change that reaches APPLIED status with an independent verifier (W04-03 acceptance, W08). Until then this half of step 1 is unverified rather than claimed

CTX-STEP-3-CHANGE-IMPACT: explicit impact links, rejection of a proposal built on an old input and conflicts preserving both sides are not asserted yet; analyzeChangeImpact additionally needs a settled orchestration fixture run, which this increment has not built

CTX-STEP-4-BLOCK-DEGRADE-UNRELATED: blocking on missing required context, degradation on a failed optional retrieval and non-invalidation by an unrelated event are the next increment of this card; the entry points are known (taskContext gate 422 GATE_FAILED, retrieval warnings list, ConsumeEvent touches only context_projection while staleness comes from applyChange) but are not asserted yet

the impact-link assertions were originally unscoped and two mutations survived them; scoping them to the links the freeze itself wrote (from_ref = this task) gave both of them teeth
several preconditions were captured once and went stale between attempts, which made refusals look like fixture noise; the closure now re-reads ProjectState per attempt
the stale-revision assertion was initially satisfied by the HTTP precondition rather than by the domain compare-and-set; it was split so each layer is exercised with the other one satisfied
